'''Tobin Harlan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as the executive officer of [[Dagger Wing]], an elite [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]]. Dagger Wing was imprisoned on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] for war crimes they did not commit, but despite their imprisonment they worked alongside the prison's guards to maintain order, and Harlan led Dagger Wing in working with [[Havoc Squad]] to battle the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] invasion of Belsavis.
